name: AI Inbox Triage: Gmail Reply Drafts with HubSpot and Slack

parameters.content:
## 1. Start and settings
The inbox check runs every 5 minutes, the digest once a day at 5 PM (n8n time zone). Both check every setting first and get a fresh Google access token from the refresh token.

## 2. Find new emails
Lists inbox mail from the last LOOKBACK_DAYS and drops every message id the ledger has already handled, or that waits for a retry. Makes sure the Gmail labels exist and loads the FAQ sheet. If the FAQ cannot be loaded, nothing is drafted.

## 3. One email at a time
Skips the business's own mail, no-reply senders, mailing lists and automatic replies. Checks the thread: an existing draft, a reply from the team or a newer message from the same sender means no new draft.

## 4. Claude triage
The email sits inside <email> tags in the user turn, never in the system prompt. One forced tool call with a strict schema. Code decides what happens: Claude cannot pick recipients or actions. A failed call is retried on a later run (backoff). After RUN_TIME_LIMIT_MINUTES the rest wait for the next run, so runs never overlap.

## 5. Draft, labels, CRM, alert
Saves the reply as a Gmail DRAFT in the same thread (users.drafts.create). This workflow never sends email: no node calls messages.send or drafts.send. Spam is only labelled. HubSpot gets the contact (no duplicates) and a note. Slack hears about anything a person must handle.

## 6. Daily digest
Counts by category, drafts saved and still waiting in Gmail, escalations and skips, from the ledger. Read only, so it never overwrites an inbox run.
